indicator.name: Manufactures imports (% of merchandise imports)
indicator.definition: Manufactures imports as a percentage of total merchandise imports.
indicator.interpretation: A higher value indicates that manufactures account for a larger share of an economy's merchandise imports. It does not measure absolute import value or identify specific trading partners.

source_metadata.source_as_pasted: World Bank indicator page and table supplied by the user.
source_metadata.data_semantics: The year and value are each economy's most recent observation as shown in the supplied table; records therefore do not all refer to the same year.
source_metadata.missing_data_handling: Blank year and value cells are represented as null and value_status=missing_in_source.
transcription_notes: Names and reported values are preserved from the supplied table.
World Bank aggregate groupings are represented as aggregate entities, separate from country/economy records.

The source page displays a World (2006) label and value 69 in one page widget, while the supplied table separately lists World (2025) = 68; the JSON preserves the supplied table's World record and notes the page-widget discrepancy.

relationship_model.reason: This indicator gives the composition of imports, not bilateral trade flows. It can enrich country/economy nodes but cannot establish exporter-importer connections.
relationship_model.data_join_note: Join to other datasets using normalized economy identifiers or ISO 3166/WB country codes where available; source labels alone may require explicit name mapping.
